Create notes.py in the repo root exposing three functions that operate on a JSON file whose path is a parameter (default 'notes.json' in the current working directory): add_note(text, path='notes.json') -> dict, list_notes(path='notes.json') -> list[dict], delete_note(index, path='notes.json') -> dict.
